questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

18 + 24 – 6 × 6 ÷ 3 = 39
questions.solution:
**By interchanging ÷ and –**

**18 + 24 ÷ 6 × 6 - 3 = 18 + 4 × 6 - 3 = 18 + 24 - 3 = 39**

By interchanging × and +

18 × 24 - 6 + 6 ÷ 3 = 18 × 24 - 6 + 2 = 432 - 6 + 2 = 428 ≠ 39

By interchanging + and –

18 - 24 + 6 × 6 ÷ 3 = 18 - 24 + 6 × 2 = 18 - 24 + 12 = 0≠39

By interchanging ÷ and +

18 div 24 - 6 times 6 + 3 = (3)/(4) - 36 + 3 = (3)/(4) - 33 ne 39

Hence, by interchanging “÷ and -” we get correct answer.

questions.question:

questions.question: The sum of the current ages of Vinayak his father is 50 years. 5 years from now, Vinayak’s age will be one - fifth of his father’s age. What is Vinayak’s current age?
questions.solution:
Vinayak’s father’s age = X

Vinayak’s age = Y

Sum of theirs ages is 50.

So,

X + Y = 5

By taking second condition,

( {X + 5} ) times (1)/(5) = ( {Y + 5} )

X + 5 = 5Y + 25

X = 5Y + 20

Putting the value of X,

5Y + 20 + Y = 50

6Y = 30

Y = 5

Hence, Vinayak’s current age is 5 years.

questions.question:
Two statement are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All owls are parrots.

Some parrots are crows.

**Conclusions:**

I. No owl is a crow.

II. All parrots are owls.

III. Some owls are crows.

options.text: Either conclusion I or III Follows
Only conclusion II and III follows.
All the conclusions, I, II and III, follow
Either conclusion I or II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible diagram is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fef30eab6a0127a8b5444a9f927014a17b7006ee8a7d047b5d538cb257fd7a9d.png] 

I. No owl is a crow → False (Possible but not definite)

II. All parrots are owls → False (Possible but not definite)

III. Some owls are crows → False (Possible but not definite)

Conclusion I and III both are false and complimentary.

Hence, either conclusion I or III Follows.

questions.question: A scientific study of rocks that deals with their composition, texture and structure; their occurrence and distribution; and their origin in relation to physicochemical conditions is called ________.

questions.question: British East India Company defeated the Portuguese in the ___________.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In 1612 the East India Company's ships defeated the Portuguese in the Swally estuary off Surat.

• This battle also convinced the English East India Company to establish a small navy to safeguard their commercial interests from other European powers and also from pirates.

questions.question: What is the ratio between the passed and failed students from college E in the year 2015?
questions.solution:
Total appeared students in college E in 2015 = 200

Number of passing students in college E in 2015 = 200 × 72/100 = 144

Number of fail students in college E in 2015 = 200 – 144 = 56

Required ratio = 144 : 56 = 18 : 7

questions.question: The efficiencies of A, B and C are in the ratio 2 : 5 : 3. Working together, they can complete task in 9 days. In how many days will C alone complete 40% of that task?
questions.solution:
The efficiencies of A, B and C are in the ratio of 2 : 5 : 3

Total work = (2 + 5 + 3) × 9 = 90

40% of the total work = 90 × 40/100 = 36

40% of the total work completed by C in = 36/3 = 12 days

questions.question: In a circle with centre O, an arc ABC subtends an angle of 140° at the centre of the circle. The chord AB is produced to point P. Then ∠CBP is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9f062edb25d7617b1b25fae06ec060eb7e3e879c75bfa35d8659917d5257db5.png] 

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre of a circle is double the size of the angle subtended by the same arc at the circle circumference

Take any point Q on the circumference and join AQ and QC .

∴ ∠AOC = 2 × ∠AQC

⇒ ∠AQC = 1/2 × ∠AOC = 1/2 × 140° = 70°

Now, ∠CBP = ∠AQC [Exterior angle of cyclic quadrilateral]

⇒ ∠CBP = 70°

Step-3 : Next, the parts of the equation that contain 'Division' and 'Multiplication' are calculated,
